scenarios.name: low
scenarios.description: Small bounded pilot matching the pending 5-8-student formative study: 6 active students, ~20 coached turns each per month (incl. 2 stage checkpoints), 1 Deep Review each, gate-selected retrieval on ~1/3 of turns, modest uploads and history.
scenarios.deployment_assumption: The documented 24/7 us-west-2 topology unchanged: EC2 t3.small + EBS, Aurora DSQL, S3, CloudFront, Cognito (Lite free tier), AgentCore Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6 Deep Review, Guardrails v4, MANAGED Knowledge Base.

lines.name: EC2 t3.small on-demand (us-west-2, 730 h)
lines.evidence: 730 h x US$0.0208/h on-demand (2025-10 pricing knowledge, unverified). Documented single-app-instance topology (compose.prod.yaml).

lines.name: EBS gp3 root/data volume (30 GB)
lines.evidence: 30 GB x US$0.08/GB-month (2025-10 pricing knowledge, unverified); Docker json-file logs and Compose volumes live on this volume.

lines.name: Aurora DSQL activity
lines.evidence: Oregon AWS list price verified 2026-11-26. DPUs aggregate active compute, reads and writes, including failed work. Idle accrues zero activity DPUs. Autosave/retry operation counts and SQLite byte growth cannot establish monthly DPUs. https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AuroraDSQL/current/us-west-2/index.json

lines.name: Haiku 4.5 input tokens (fast chat + checkpoints + retries)
lines.evidence: 6 students x 20 turns x ~8k tokens (ticket 40 measured system prompt p50 ~7.7k estimator tokens) + checkpoints, x1.25 retry allowance (ticket 48 measured one OCC conflict per student per wave, 100% fresh-base retry). US$1.00/Mtok (2025-10 knowledge, unverified); prompt-cache discounts excluded (conservative).

lines.name: Haiku 4.5 output tokens
lines.evidence: ~0.6k output tokens/turn + checkpoints, x1.25 retries. US$5.00/Mtok (2025-10 knowledge, unverified).

lines.name: Sonnet 4.6 input tokens (Deep Review + retries)
lines.evidence: 6 Deep Reviews x ~30k input, x1.25 retry allowance (ticket 48 measured Deep Reviews complete under load; ambiguous outcomes stay billable per policy). US$3.00/Mtok (2025-10 knowledge, unverified).

lines.name: Sonnet 4.6 output tokens (Deep Review + retries)
lines.evidence: 6 Deep Reviews x ~3k output, x1.25 retries. US$15.00/Mtok (2025-10 knowledge, unverified).

lines.name: AgentCore Runtime invocations
lines.evidence: Flat US$0.005/invocation planning estimate for vCPU/memory-seconds (2025-10 AgentCore Runtime pricing knowledge, unverified); 120 fast-chat invocations + 6 Deep Reviews weighted x10 for the 200 s timeout profile. Actual metered pricing may differ materially.

lines.name: Bedrock Guardrails v4 evaluations
lines.evidence: US$0.001/evaluation planning estimate (2025-10 Guardrails pricing knowledge, unverified); one evaluation per model invocation, Guardrails version 4 documented in compose.prod.yaml.

lines.name: Knowledge Base Retrieve queries (MANAGED)
lines.evidence: US$2.50 per 1,000 Retrieve queries planning estimate (2025-10 knowledge, unverified); the deterministic gate selects ~1/3 of turns for retrieval. MANAGED-tier infrastructure pricing is not separately verified.

lines.name: Embeddings / KB sync amortized
lines.evidence: Amortized monthly embedding volume for course sync and reindexing (assumption); ~US$0.13/Mtok embedding-class pricing (2025-10 knowledge, unverified); one-time course ingestion amortized over 12 months.

lines.name: S3 Standard objects (uploads + course materials)
lines.evidence: 2 GB x US$0.023/GB-month (2025-10 pricing knowledge, unverified); ticket 48's measured 80-student run stored ~3.4 MB of application state locally, so volumes here are corpus-dominated assumptions.

lines.evidence: S3 copy-storage planning estimate (2025-10 knowledge, unverified). Separate AWS Backup for DSQL is outside this assumed S3 copy workflow and would need its own inventory line if enabled.
